semiconductor_relevance: Low — Festo primarily focuses on automation technology and factory automation solutions rather than semiconductor-specific products.
summary: Festo Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of automation technology, providing pneumatic and electric solutions for factory and process automation across various industries. While they serve sectors like automotive and electronics, their offerings do not specifically target semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Festo Co., Ltd. was founded in Taiwan in 1979 and has established branch offices in Taichung and Kaohsiung to better serve local customers.
